title: Improve ticket search, inline editing and checklists
description: A person opens the ticket list, searches by visible key or stable ID, and gets matching parent or child tickets. From a ticket detail page they change fields directly; each field saves automatically when focus leaves it or its selection changes, with clear saving and error feedback. Checks required by labels appear immediately on the ticket, and the person can add ticket-specific checks alongside them.
why: Make the ticket workflow quick and discoverable: find tickets by visible ID and nested work, edit fields directly with autosave, and show persistent checks that come from labels plus ticket-specific additions.

acceptance.text: Search by ticket key and stable ID, including subtasks
Ticket fields save on blur or selection change, with visible save and conflict feedback
Checklist tags provide reusable checks without preview

todos.text: Inspect the ticket UI, API and checklist data model
implement ticket search by key and stable ID, including descendants
replace the ticket edit mode with inline autosaving fields
make reusable label-driven checks visible and combine them with individual checks
add focused regression coverage and update product docs
Re-run npm run check on a Windows runner with symlink and loopback permissions before closing
